summary: Executed backend+frontend end-to-end regression for cashier redesign and auth playbook checks on public preview URL. Cashier flows passed (customer mode pricing, picker/add, qty +/- and delete, manual service, payment summary, local customer modal save, submit transaction, and edit existing transaction load). One backend auth hardening issue remains on CORS credential policy.

critical.issue: Public endpoint returns access-control-allow-origin: * and no access-control-allow-credentials=true header in preflight response, not matching credentialed explicit-origin auth playbook requirement.

action_items: Fix ingress/backend CORS behavior for credentialed auth flows: ensure explicit origin reflection and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true on preflight and actual responses.
Optional cleanup: remove temporary UI seed item TEST_UI_MODE_ITEM_9 if not needed.
Type hygiene: align frontend TransactionPayload with backend (include customer_mode; remove unsupported kartu payment option).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/lib/api.ts TransactionPayload type omits customer_mode while cashier sends it; current cast-to-unknown bypasses type safety.
frontend/lib/api.ts payment_method union includes 'kartu' but backend accepts only tunai/transfer/qris.
frontend/lib/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; project guideline asks EXPO_BACKEND_URL as source-of-truth key.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested cashier redesign flows in final rerun

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_MODE_ITEM_9 via public API to verify UI customer-mode price switching (consumer_price vs workshop_price).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cashier redesign behaves correctly on mobile viewport 375x667 in public preview: mode switch changes cart price for known differential item; item picker/cart interactions and transaction submit/edit roundtrip work. One unresolved issue is CORS credentials behavior from public edge response.
rca_of_issue: RCA: CORS failure is reproducible with OPTIONS /api/auth/login + Origin header to preview domain; response returns wildcard allow-origin and omits allow-credentials, indicating edge/ingress CORS override or mismatch with app middleware expectations. Mitigation: enforce credentialed CORS at edge to mirror app policy (explicit origin + allow credentials).
